candidate.answerReason: Each summand equals one tenth, so their sum is three tenths.

methods.label: Express every fraction in tenths
methods.explanation:
Reduce the fractions first so that all three terms are expressed in tenths. Dividing the numerator and denominator of \(2/20\) by \(2\), and those of \(3/30\) by \(3\), gives
\[
\frac1{10}+\frac2{20}+\frac3{30}
=\frac1{10}+\frac1{10}+\frac1{10}
=\frac3{10}=0.3.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
methods.levelReason: Reducing fractions, adding tenths, and writing a decimal are elementary AMC 8 skills.

candidate.annotationRationale: The task adds fractions initially written with different denominators. The method obtains a common denominator through reduction, then uses same-denominator addition and converts the result to a decimal. Finding a least common multiple is unnecessary for this route.
